notes.title: Master of the Harem Guild 1.4.0.200 released!
Harem Guild: Version 1.1 LIVE
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

The first update since Harem Guild's launch has just gone live! We've added a bunch of features (some new and some returning from our older titles) and made a [b]ton[/b] of grammatical corrections to the script.

Here is a brief rundown of things we've added:
[list]
[*] A Chapter Select screen
[*] A [i]H-Scene[/i] Select screen (use your imagination to figure out what that is for)
[*] A Voice Replay button
[*] Sara's sprite now appears to be asleep during certain sections of the game.
[*] Tina's sprite now will appear transparent when she is using her stealth skills.
[*] A 'fade to black' break between chapters.
[*] Spelling and Grammar fixes provided by a member of the Cherry Kiss Discord who would like to be credited as -R, so a special thanks out to them for their dedication! Thank you! 
[/list]

We are actively checking our [url=https://twitter.com/CherryKissGames]Twitter [/url]and [url=https://discord.gg/3hTEeBC]Discord [/url]for feedback on features the community would like to see added to our releases so feel free to reach out to us and let us know what you're looking for in Cherry Kiss releases!
